article.story: Colorado (4-6) at Cincinnati (5-5), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Cincinnati by 3.5. Against the spread: Cincinnati 5-5, Colorado 3-6-1. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Cincinnati Offense Overall: 442.3 yards per game (24th in FBS) Passing: 215.3 yards per game (82nd) Rushing: 227 yards per game (9th) Scoring: 31 points per game (44th) Cincinnati Defense Overall: 455.9 yards per game (135th in FBS) Passing: 275 yards per game (133rd) Rushing: 180.9 yards per game (113th) Scoring: 30.6 points per game (116th) Colorado Offense Overall: 394.9 yards per game (55th in FBS) Passing: 251.6 yards per game (34th) Rushing: 143.3 yards per game (87th) Scoring: 22 points per game (108th) Colorado Defense Overall: 387 yards per game (97th in FBS) Passing: 246 yards per game (120th) Rushing: 141 yards per game (65th) Scoring: 28.7 points per game (104th) Cincinnati is 117th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 43% of the time. Colorado ranks 57th on offense, converting on 40.9% of third downs. Colorado ranks 135th in the FBS with a -10 turnover margin, compared to Cincinnati's 35th-ranked +4 margin. Colorado ranks 128th in the FBS with 73.8 penalty yards per game. Team leaders Cincinnati Passing: J.C. French, 2,087 yards, 16 TDs, 3 INTs, 66.2 completion percentage Rushing: Cole Tabb, 977 yards on 107 carries, 10 TDs Receiving: JaVonnie Gibson, 515 yards on 39 catches, 4 TDs Colorado Passing: Isaac Wilson, 1,629 yards, 9 TDs, 9 INTs, 62.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jaquail Smith, 440 yards on 87 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Joseph Williams, 933 yards on 63 catches, 7 TDs Last game Cincinnati was defeated by Iowa State 41-13 on Nov. 14. French threw for 97 yards on 14-of-23 attempts (60.9%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 41 yards. Tabb had 165 rushing yards on 16 carries, adding eight receptions for 70 yards. Lyviel Waters had two receptions for 15 yards and one touchdown. Colorado won 42-32 over Houston on Nov. 13. Wilson led Colorado with 217 yards on 17-of-25 passing (68.0%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball eight times for 25 yards. Richard Young had 99 rushing yards on 21 carries and two touchdowns. Williams had five receptions for 80 yards and one touchdown. Next game Cincinnati plays at No. 12 BYU on Nov. 28. Colorado hosts UCF on Nov. 28.
